messages:
Alex (partnerships): FYI CloudNest (marketplace vendor) just pinged us — they're hitting auth + behavioral differences on SDK v2 after our infra tweak. Can we sync timelines and partner comms?
Tara (ecosys): Thanks Alex. Do we know whether it's a breaking change in contract (headers/payload) or just a bug in the runtime? :eyes:
Jordan (eng): Quick triage — looks like two things: header name change (we moved to `x-rdwd-auth` from `authorization` in the shim) and a small param rename for batch endpoints. Both are breaking for their integration.
Maria (product): Oof. We need a clear deprecation plan. CloudNest is in marketplace and a top 10 partner for CPL. Priorities: timeline, migration docs, and marketplace notice draft.
Priya (solutions): I can offer a migration hands-on session for their SIs. Also we should propose a compatibility shim patch that restores old headers for a grace period.
Alex (partnerships): Agree. Proposed immediate steps: 1) Hold a quick call with CloudNest tomorrow, 2) Publish a short compatibility shim and publish a migration guide, 3) Final sunset + grace schedule for marketplace listings. Any objections?
Jordan (eng): No objections. ETA for shim: EOD tomorrow if we scope it to header alias + param fallback. I'll tag infra to gate the rollout for marketplace nodes only.
Tara (ecosys): I'll block time with CloudNest for tomorrow. Also cc'ing MarketplaceBot for a formal marketplace listing flag.
MarketplaceBot: Automated alert: Ticket #4325 created by CloudNest: "SDK v2: auth header mismatch after 2026-03-18 runtime update". Current severity: medium.
Maria (product): Draft timeline suggestion: announce deprecation + migration docs this week, offer 60-day grace with shim enabled by default, sunset after 90 days (configurable for enterprise partners). Thoughts?
Priya (solutions): 60 days feels tight for some SI workflows. Could we do 90-day default + option for partners to opt into earlier sunset for testing? Also propose a three-phase marketplace banner: notice, pinned migration guide, final removal.
Alex (partnerships): Let's aim for 90-day default. We should also give high-touch support (2 weeks) for top marketplace partners like CloudNest.
Jordan (eng): Technical note: enabling shim by default has perf overhead ~0.5% for our edge nodes. That's acceptable short-term but we should scope rollback automation. I'll add a feature flag with canary rollout and metrics.
Tara (ecosys): Who owns partner comms? Alex -> partnerships will draft a notice. Maria can review product wording. Marketing to approve external language.
Maria (product): I'll draft the comms and put it in the Marketing review channel. We should include migration snippet (code) and a table of breaking changes. Also a recommended client upgrade path showing SDK v3 usage.
Priya (solutions): Migration snippet for partners (copyable):
```
// client v2 -> v3 header shim example
fetch(url, {
  headers: {
    'authorization': token || undefined,
    'x-rdwd-auth': token || undefined
  }
})
```
Keep it simple in the guide.
Jordan (eng): Also include server-side example for the batch param fallback: if `batch_size` missing, look for `batchLimit`. I'll add that to the repo with tests.
Alex (partnerships): Assignments: Alex will run partner call + comms draft; Maria will review; Tara will coordinate CloudNest demo time; Jordan will ship shim + feature flag; Priya will prepare migration session materials. Can we confirm owners here?
Alex (partnerships): I'll take comms and partner call owner.
Maria (product): I'll own wording review and marketplace listing copy.
Tara (ecosys): I will schedule the call with CloudNest and their SI leads.
Jordan (eng): I'll own shim, tests, and gated rollout. Expect PR by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (solutions): I'll prepare a 45-minute migration workshop and sample slide deck.
Alex (partnerships): Timeline check: call tomorrow (May 2), shim PR EOD May 2, docs + comms ready May 4, publish marketplace notice May 4, enable shim + canary May 5, grace period until Aug 3 (90 days). Are those solid?
Jordan (eng): May 5 canary OK. Will monitor error rate and latency for marketplace nodes.
Tara (ecosys): Confirmed — call scheduled May 2 at 10am PT. CloudNest SRE + SI lead attending.
Maria (product): I'll draft the notice and ping marketing for approval; will add a link to the migration guide and the deprecation FAQ.
Alex (partnerships): Add legal for any contract exceptions — CloudNest requested extended support if needed.
Priya (solutions): Noted. I'll prep a runbook for the migration session and a checklist for customers.
Jordan (eng): Logging/telemetry note: add a distinct metric `sdk_compat_shim_used` and an alert if >10% inbound requests use shim after 30 days — we want to track adoption.
Alex (partnerships): Good call. Jordan, can you also surface a compatibility matrix (versions vs breaking changes) in the internal doc?
Jordan (eng): Yep. I'll update the internal marketplace partner doc at `go/internal/marketplace/compatibility` and paste link once done.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder scheduled: post public marketplace banner on May 4 at 09:00 UTC.
Tara (ecosys): Anything else?
Maria (product): Let's also note any docs we need to update (SDK changelog, API reference, onboarding samples). I'll compile a list.
Priya (solutions): I'll run the migration workshop replay and record it for other partners.
Alex (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the CloudNest recap after the call and post the thread update here with links. :thumbsup:
Tara (ecosys): :+1:
Jordan (eng): :rocket:
Maria (product): :white_check_mark:
